______ it easy. Everything will be fine.

This is a part of your body under the skin that helps you move. It lets you do everything from smiling to running!

04. 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: What's wrong?
B: I have a bloody nose.
A: That's too bad. You should get some rest. And don't forget to ________.
B: Okay. Thank you.

[05-08] 다음 대화를 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
B: Good morning, Ms. Kang. I'm not feeling well.
W: What's wrong? (①)
B: I have a bad stomachache. (②) It hurt so much when I woke up this morning.
W: What did you eat last night?
B: I ate spicy noodles late at night.
W: Spicy food can sometimes cause stomach pain. (③) Eating late is also not good.
B: I see. What should I do?
W: (④) You should take this medicine, too. (⑤)
B: Okay, I will. Thank you, Ms. Kang.
W: You're welcome. Don't forget to tell your teacher if your stomach still hurts.
05. 위 대화의 ①~⑤ 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

She ________ my gift.
10. 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
answers: The tea is so hot that I can't drink it. = The tea is too hot to drink.
The story was so sad that I cried. = I cried because the story was so sad.
The water was so cold that I couldn't swim. = The water was cold enough to swim.
The soup was so salty that I couldn't finish it
He was so hungry that he ate three sandwiches
questions.explainKo: 정답은 3번입니다. (The water was so cold that I couldn't swim. = The water was cold enough to swim.)

questions.question: 11. 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 문맥상 어색한 것은?
answers: She ran so fast that nobody could catch her.
He is so careful that he never makes a mistake.
The dog is so clever that it can open the door.
The movie was so funny that everyone laughed.
The test was so difficult that many students passed.
questions.explainKo: 정답은 5번입니다. (The test was so difficult that many students passed.)

Today, we will talk about sleep. Ready? Let's go!
Sleep is very important that you can't live without it. When you sleep, your body repairs your cells and muscles. So, if you don't get enough sleep, you can get sick.
Sleep is important for your physical health. And it is also important for your ⓐ memory. (A) This makes space for new memories. (B) While you sleep, your brain clears memories that are not needed.
